products.name: AlphaSense
products.note: Market intelligence AI; financial research; insider information risk; MNPI controls needed

profile_text.body:
AlphaSense describes itself as an AI-powered market intelligence and search platform, offering users the ability to find company insights, market data, and research across more than 500 million documents. The platform is positioned toward business and financial decision-making, and the company markets it as capable of generating outputs with sentence-level citations and no hallucinations, drawing on what it calls high-quality content not available elsewhere. Named users of the platform mentioned on the site include Recurve Capital's Aaron Chan and the firm Royalty Pharma, which the site says uses the platform for due diligence and biopharma market intelligence.

The company's AI features include Smart Synonyms, Expert Insights, AI search, and a product called Deep Research, which the site describes as giving users access to generative AI reasoning models applied across content sets. AlphaSense states it received the highest possible score across 14 criteria in an unnamed report, which also characterizes the company as having "dominated the market with its vision of marrying premier and exclusive content with domain-specific AI for an end-to-end intelligence and decision-support platform."

The site's held facts classify AlphaSense under Finance and Legal AI, and note that use of the platform carries insider information risk and that MNPI controls are needed, reflecting the sensitivity of the financial research content the platform handles. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
